title: Page 1
content_zh:
自远古尧舜以降，上自皇族贵胄，下至贩夫走卒，“吃”，无疑是众人心中大事。可会吃不代表懂吃，尤其擅长割烹、刀火超群的名厨，更是少之又少。
当时盛传一段顺口溜——
“北吃前门‘一条龙’，南至河畔‘小莲庄’”。
凡举开席宴客，若不进“一条龙”或“小莲庄”，旁人一定会笑称白吃了一顿；在当时，无人不把“一条龙”跟“小莲庄”，视作天馔美食的象征……
第1章(1)
住在皇城郊外的石枣儿扮成男孩，蹦蹦跳跳出了门。
“老爹，您瞧我这打扮可以吗？”
黄老爹好生打量，最后点点头。“我想你爹看你这身打扮，铁定百味杂陈。”
“枣儿听不懂。”枣儿低头瞧瞧自己，一脸不解。
“你想世上有几个爹，会舍得让自个儿闺女抛头露面？”更别提枣儿这丫头，个头娇小人又长得稚气，穿起男装来还真雌雄莫辨。黄老爹再叹。
刚才醒来，就见枣儿这女娃急忙跑来，黄老爹到她家一瞧才知道，她爹石老庐刚自床上跌下，扭了腰，怕十天半个月下不了床。
石家就这一老一小相依为命，平常就靠石老庐在“一条龙”饭庄洗碗担水劈柴，赚点现钱。现下石老庐伤着了，他要黄老爹帮忙请个假，关于这点，黄老爹倒不敢一口允下。
石老庐这身子，少说也要十天八天才会好，要“一条龙”那么大的饭庄十天八天少个担水劈柴的帮手，唉，想也知道依他们当家掌杓龙爷的个性，铁定会要老卢收拾包袱回家，以后别来了。
结果枣儿这丫头就说她愿意扮成男孩帮她爹忙，还跪下求了半天，黄老爹才勉为其难地答应帮忙。
“情势所逼嘛！”枣儿自己倒没半点怨艾。爹是她仅存的家人，现下遇上了这个麻烦，她自当负起维持家计的责任。“不过我常听我爹说，当家的龙爷脾气不好？”
“说起龙爷脾气，我差点忘了。”黄老爹突然停下脚步。“先说好，等进了‘一条龙’，你少开口多做事。我们龙爷最忌女人进他灶房，你可千万别被他发现。要不，害惨的不只是你爹，还有我，懂不懂？”
枣儿被吓得一张脸惨白惨白，她连连点头。
“还有，要人问起年纪，就说今年十三，千万别说溜嘴了。”
“为什么？”
“你声音太脆，一听就不像十五、六岁的男孩。”黄老爹考虑得真周全。

“好，我会
两人一前一后进了城门，街市已三三两两摆起了小摊。黄老爹左拐右拐进了小巷，沿着恍若见不着底的石墙一路走，终于来到一扇红门前。黄老爹敲敲门，门扉一开，站他身后的枣儿眼儿蓦地瞠大。
多大啊！
枣儿没法估计，眼前庭院总共有几亩地。二楼高的罩棚下，排排放置许多她这辈子还没见过的菜蔬，十几堆人勤奋埋头工作，人群后边，立着一幢人声鼎沸的长屋；从她站的地方望去，可以看见许多人在里边走动。
“这就是‘一条龙’的灶房。”见着枣儿好奇的目光，黄老爹压低声音说：“我现在就带你去见账房，运气好的话，你马上就能接替你爹的工了。”
很不巧，黄老爹与枣儿找到账房时，他们最怕的当家——龙焱，正好走了过来。
“怎么一群人围在这儿？”
“龙爷。”账房与黄老爹同时喊。
枣儿正想转头，一股热气却突然贴近她的背。她侧头偷瞄，先是瞧见一身精致的黑缎子长袍，再往上移，蓦地发现人称“易牙再世”的“一条龙”当家，竟是如此俊美好看的男人！
他一双浓眉斜插入额，底下眼瞳深幽地发亮，鼻子很挺直，抿紧的嘴角看起来无比冷静。可怎么说呢？枣儿过了会儿才想到，眼前这双眼，竟毫无笑意。
她瞧见的，只是满满的孤绝与寂寞。
她有没有看错？!枣儿忍不住多盯了一会儿。掌管这么大庄子，又日进斗金的富贵人，他也会觉得寂寞？
黑眸对上她打量的眼，枣儿察觉失礼，脸一红，忙又将脸垂下。
“他是谁？”龙焱下巴朝枣儿一点。
“石老庐的儿子。”账房回答，然后望向黄老爹。“你刚说他叫什么？”
“石……”黄老爹顿了下。“石草，他叫石草。”
黄老爹刚才想到，一个男孩叫“枣儿”，怎么听怎么奇怪，才突然帮她改了名。
枣儿眼睛与黄老爹对上，他眉一皱要她别多话。枣儿摸摸脸又将头垂了下去。
龙焱再问：“石老庐呢？”
账房答：“说是今早下床时不小心摔伤了腰，所以才要他儿子过来替工几天。”

“是是是。”黄老爹挲着手附和。“龙爷也知道石老庐家穷，很需要这份工作……”
龙焱抬手截住黄老爹话，看着枣儿问：“你几岁？”
“十三。”又是黄老爹代答，顺便又夸了枣儿几句。“别看这小子年纪小，平常石老庐到外头工作，他一个人就把房子里外打点得好好，很能干的。”
枣儿谨遵黄老爹吩咐，不敢多说话，只是间断地配合点头。
龙焱瞧瞧石草细致的脸蛋，再瞧他纤细的手脚，就知他胜任不了他爹的工作——要知道饭庄子用水极多，粗略估计，几个杂工整天少也得挑个百来趟。
差使一个十三岁的男孩担此粗活，龙焱暗忖自己还没这等狠心肠。“他做不来。”他突然看着账房吩咐：“把老崔、老夏喊来。”
“是。”账房喊声。
“龙爷……”黄老爹想帮枣儿说情，又担心触怒了龙焱。庄子上下伙计谁不清楚，他们这个当家，虽然平常不太骂人，可一发起脾气，简直像天崩地裂，任谁也挡不了！
枣儿左一瞧黄老爹，右一瞧龙焱冷淡的脸，一时情急，只好跪了下去。
“求龙爷给我一个机会……”枣儿心想，要被爹知道他工作没了，铁定难过极了——一想到这儿，她频频磕头。“石草保证尽心尽力，绝对不偷懒……”
“你跪什么，起来。”龙焱皱眉喝道：“没听过‘男儿膝下有黄金’？”
枣儿定在地上不肯放弃，就在这时，账房领着老崔跟老夏走来。
“龙爷。”老崔、老夏同时唤。
龙焱转头看着他俩吩咐：“石老庐摔着腰，这几天你们先顶他的位子，原本的工作，交给他。”他朝仍跪在地上的枣儿一点。
这正是他没说出口的打算。虽然多说几句解释清楚就得了，偏偏他脾气不爱多话，总想着事情能照他意思做就好，也不管其它人会不会因他的寡言产生了误会。
枣儿惊讶抬头。
“还不起来！”龙焱喝。
原来他刚说她不行，不是打算拒绝她？!枣儿杏眼圆瞠。想不到传说中坏脾气的龙大当家，竟是这般的好心人！
“谢谢龙爷……”
“记得你刚才的承诺，石老庐工作尽责，我之所以留下你全是看在你爹跟黄老爹的面子，你别丢了他俩的脸。”

“不会，我一定尽心尽力……”
不等枣儿说完，龙焱袖一甩走了。
不过枣儿发觉，跟人换了工作的她，也没占到多少便宜。老崔、老夏原本负责的工作是擦碗搬桌，她做了一天才知道，“一条龙”每天用上的锅碗瓢盆，堆起来足是两座大山。且龙焱非常重视盘器是否干净，凡摸起来略有油花，或上头仍残着水滴，他一律会退回要她再行擦洗。
content_en:
Since the time of Yao and Shun in ancient times, "eating" has undoubtedly been a major concern for everyone, from the royal family and nobles to the peddlers and foot soldiers. But knowing how to eat doesn't mean you know how to eat. There are very few famous chefs who are good at kappo and have excellent knife skills.
There was a popular jingle at that time——
"Eat the 'Yilong' at Qianmen in the north and 'Xiaolianzhuang' by the river in the south."
Whenever you have a banquet, if you don't enter "Yilong" or "Xiaolianzhuang", others will laugh and say that your meal is in vain; at that time, everyone regarded "Yilong" and "Xiaolianzhuang" as symbols of heavenly delicacies...
Chapter 1(1)
Shi Zaoer, who lives on the outskirts of the imperial city, dressed up as a boy and jumped out of the house.
"Dad, do you think I'm dressed up like this?"
Father Huang looked at it carefully and finally nodded. "I think your father will definitely have mixed feelings when he sees you dressed like this."
"Zao'er doesn't understand." Zao'er lowered his head and looked at himself with a puzzled look on his face.
"How many fathers do you think there are in the world who would be willing to let their daughters appear in public?" Not to mention this girl Zao'er, who is petite and looks childish, and she can't tell the difference between male and female when wearing men's clothes. Father Huang sighed again.
When I woke up just now, I saw the girl Zao'er running towards her in a hurry. When Father Huang came to her house, he found out that her father, Shi Laolu, had just fallen off the bed and twisted his waist. He was afraid that he would not be able to get out of bed for ten days and a half.
The Shi family, consisting of the old and the young, relies on Shi Laolu to earn some cash by washing dishes, carrying water and chopping firewood at the "One-stop" restaurant. Now that Shi Laolu was injured, he asked Father Huang to help him take a leave. Regarding this, Father Huang did not dare to agree to it.
Shi Laolu's condition will take at least ten days or eight days to get better. A restaurant as big as a "one-stop" would need ten days or eight days without a helper to carry water and chop firewood. Alas, I also knew that with the personality of their boss, Mr. Long, he would definitely ask Lao Lu to pack up and go home, and not come back again.
As a result, the girl Zaoer said that she was willing to dress up as a boy and help her father, and she even knelt down and begged for a long time before Father Huang reluctantly agreed to help.
"It's forced by the situation!" Zao'er herself didn't feel any resentment at all. Her father is her only remaining family member. Now that she is in trouble, she should take the responsibility of maintaining the family. "But I often hear my dad say that the head of the family, Mr. Long, has a bad temper?"
"Speaking of Mr. Long's temper, I almost forgot." Father Huang suddenly stopped. "Let's make an agreement first. When you enter the 'Yilong', you will speak less and do more. Our Lord Long is most afraid of women entering his kitchen. You must not be discovered by him. Otherwise, it will not only be your father, but also me. Do you understand?"
Zaoer was so frightened that her face turned pale, and she nodded repeatedly.
"Also, if someone asks you your age, just say you are thirteen this year. Don't slip up."
"Why?"
"Your voice is too crisp, and it doesn't sound like a fifteen or sixteen-year-old boy." Father Huang was really thoughtful.
"Okay, I will
The two of them entered the city gate one after another, and small stalls had been set up in twos and threes in the market. Father Huang turned left and right into the alley, walked along the seemingly bottomless stone wall, and finally came to a red door. Father Huang knocked on the door, and when the door opened, Zaoer's eyes suddenly widened as he stood behind him.
How big!
Zao'er couldn't estimate how many acres of land there were in the courtyard in front of her. Under the canopy on the second floor, many vegetables that she had never seen before were placed in rows. More than a dozen people were hard at work. Behind the crowd stood a long house that was bustling with people. From where she stood, she could see many people walking around inside.
“This is the ‘one-stop’ kitchen. Seeing Zaoer's curious gaze, Huang Dad lowered his voice and said, "I will take you to see the accountant now. If you are lucky, you will be able to take over your father's job soon." "
Unfortunately, when Mr. Huang and Zaoer found the counting house, the boss they were most afraid of - Long Yan, happened to come over.
"Why are there a bunch of people gathered here? "
"Master Long. "The accountant and Father Huang shouted at the same time.
Zao'er was about to turn her head when a burst of hot air suddenly came close to her back. herTurning to the side and taking a peek, first I saw an exquisite black satin robe, and then moving up, I suddenly discovered that the "Yilong" leader known as "Yi Ya Reincarnated" was actually such a handsome and good-looking man!
His thick eyebrows slanted into his forehead, his pupils were deeply shining, his nose was straight, and his pursed mouth looked extremely calm. But what to say? It took Zao'er a while to realize that the eyes in front of her were not smiling at all.
All she saw was loneliness and loneliness.
Did she get it wrong? !Zaoer couldn't help but stare for a while longer. A rich man who is in charge of such a big village and makes a lot of money every day, would he also feel lonely?
His dark eyes met her appraising eyes. Zao'er noticed the rudeness, blushed, and quickly lowered his face.
"Who is he?" Long Yan tilted his chin toward Zao'er.
"Shi Laolu's son." The accountant replied, and then looked at Huang Lao. "What did you just say his name was?"
"Shi..." Huang Dad paused. "Shi Cao, his name is Shi Cao."
Father Huang just thought that a boy named "Zao'er" sounded strange, so he suddenly changed her name.
Zaoer's eyes met Huang's, and he frowned and told her not to talk too much. Zao'er touched her face and lowered her head.
Long Yan asked again: "Where is Shi Laolu?"
The accountant replied: "He said he accidentally broke his waist when he got out of bed this morning, so he asked his son to come over and replace him for a few days."
"Yes, yes, yes." Father Huang agreed, waving his hands. "Long Ye also knows that Shi Laolu's family is poor and needs this job very much..."
Long Yan raised his hand to intercept Huang's words, looked at Zao'er and asked, "How old are you?"
"Thirteen." Father Huang answered again and praised Zao'er a few more times. "Despite his young age, Shi Laolu usually works outside, but he manages the house well both inside and outside by himself. He is very capable."
Zao'er obeyed Huang's instructions and did not dare to say much. She just nodded intermittently in cooperation.
Long Yan looked at Shi Cao's delicate face, and then at his slender hands and feet, and knew that he was not qualified for his father's job - the restaurant used a lot of water, and it was roughly estimated that several handymen would have to make hundreds of trips a day.
Assigning a thirteen-year-old boy to do such a rough job, Long Yan secretly thought that he was not so cruel yet. "He can't do it." He suddenly looked at the accountant and ordered: "Call Lao Cui and Lao Xia."
"Yes." The accountant shouted.
"Master Long..." Huang wanted to intercede for Zao'er, but he was worried about offending Long Yan. Zhuangzi's subordinates and subordinates don't know it. Although their boss usually doesn't curse, when he loses his temper, it's like the sky is falling apart, and no one can stop him!
Zao'er looked at Huang's father from the left and Long Yan's cold face from the right. In a moment of urgency, she had no choice but to kneel down.
"Please Lord Long, give me a chance..." Zao'er thought to herself, her father would definitely be extremely sad if he found out that he had lost his job - when she thought of this, she kowtowed frequently. "Shi Cao promises to do his best and will never be lazy..."
"Why are you kneeling? Get up." Long Yan frowned and shouted: "Have you never heard of 'a man has gold under his knees'?"
Zaoer was fixed on the ground and refused to give up. At this moment, the accountant led Lao Cui and Lao Xia over.
"Lord Long." Lao Cui and Lao Xia called at the same time.
Long Yan turned to look at them and ordered: "Shi Laolu fell down on his back. You will take his place these days and leave the original work to him." He pointed towards Zao'er who was still kneeling on the ground.
This was his unspoken intention. Although it would be enough to explain clearly with a few more words, he doesn't like to talk much because of his temper. He always wants things to be done as he wants, regardless of whether other people may misunderstand because of his reticence.
Zaoer looked up in surprise.
"Don't get up yet!" Long Yan shouted.
It turns out that he just said she couldn't do it, wasn't he planning to reject her? !Zaoer has round, almond-shaped eyes. I never expected that the legendary bad-tempered Master Long would be such a kind-hearted person!
"Thank you Lord Long..."
"Remember your promise just now, Shi Laolu works conscientiously, the reason why I keep you is all for the sake of your father and Huang Lao, don’t embarrass them both. "
"No, I will try my best..."
Before Zaoer could finish speaking, Long Yan swung his sleeves and walked away.
However, Zaoer discovered that even though she had changed jobs with someone else, she didn't get much advantage. Lao Cui and Lao Xia were originally responsible for wiping dishes and moving tables. After working for a day, she realized that the pots and pans used by the "one-stop service" every day were piled up to two mountains. And Long Yan attaches great importance to whether the dishes are clean. If they feel slightly oily or have water droplets on them, he will return them and ask her to scrub them again.
